Name: Zichri, Father of Amasiah
Summary: Zichri was the father of Amasiah, a captain of thousands under Jehoshaphat.
KeyStory: Zichri is named only as the father of Amasiah, who willingly offered himself unto the LORD.
LifeLesson: God's law taught throughout the land, and willing service under a faithful king, strengthened Judah.
